verdict.rationale: Lovable has no automation or workflow primitive in the evidence, but the projects it builds, including backend functions, can be versioned and reviewed. Git sync to GitHub/GitLab keeps the code in sync and supports reviewing changes in pull requests and testing on branches. Build mode shows file diffs and summaries for every change, and edit history can be checked. However, no in-product rollback or restore is documented; reverting only appears possible through Git. Missing for 10: an automation-specific versioning concept, a documented one-click rollback or version restore, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the review and rollback flow.
